text:
Based on the onboarding document, Ollama Cloud requires routing to the `/v1` endpoint:

* **Ollama Cloud Endpoint**: Ollama Cloud requests must route to **`https://ollama.com/v1`**. 

Your debug output shows the request is attempting to call `https://ollama.com/api`, which returns a `404 Not Found` error. 

### Resolution
Ensure your configuration uses:
* **`provider: ollama-cloud`**
* If specifying the base URL manually in `config.yaml`, ensure it is set to **`https://ollama.com/v1`** rather than `/api`.
